Protocol v0.1 corrects the declared profile; the harness must derive target identity from the served capability manifest and the witness must be prospectively rerun before any comparison run.

The local-streaming witness covers cross-user list, lookup, and update denial but not cross-user delete refusal, which the frozen fixture and LLP 0065 both require; the generated-owner claim is narrowed to the witnessed subset until a real-server negative delete witness is retained.
